Mind - Left, strategic. Good self-motivation.
Your mind sifts out everything unnecessary and remembers only what it considers necessary or useful. You are able to motivate yourself much better than external factors, other people or life circumstances will do.
Perspective - Left, active. Focused vision.
The perspective of your outlook is directed towards actively seeking opportunities for survival and self-fulfilment. You are not used to sitting around waiting for something. You quickly get bored with the same environment, people or situations.
Brain and Body - Left. Active nervous system.
You are perfectly adapted to surviving in the outside world. The left body that works more efficiently when one is physically active. It is helpful to move more, follow the dietary regimen and the diet that corresponds to your primary health system (PHS).
Environment - Left, active. You need a stimulating environment.
Your living space should dispose you to be active or provide people who motivate you to be active. You will feel more comfortable in an active environment that stimulates your nervous system to be active.
Brief Report on the PLL - DLL Variable

All the four Variables in your chart have the left, active orientation. The first and most important step you can take towards your awareness is to follow your Type's strategy and delegate decision-making to your inner Authority. Only then will your mind be able to understand what it really needs to focus on.

You have a logical mindset and an active, focused outlook on life. Such people always have a plan of action or strategy for success in their heads. Being a practical and rational person, you are constantly looking for an opportunity to improve your life in material terms by establishing household comfort.

In addition to this, you have an active brain and a physically developed body, so it is important to nourish them regularly and properly. Physical activity is a rewarding and natural process for you. You are a person with innate extrovert traits who feels more comfortable in an active environment.

Such people can be quite conservative. It is natural for them to honour family traditions and demand the same from their loved ones. They value practicality and realism, so they tend to get their life in order in almost everything. They are organised, sociable and enjoy learning, especially in the exact and applied sciences. The abstract and unexplainable does not interest them.
